_note: Gate for runs scored by the LLM judge (CA_FAITHFULNESS_SCORER=judge). The floors under `metrics` block, as in gate.json. Judge-scored faithfulness is a `target`: reported as 'target not met' on every run and regression-checked against the baseline, but not blocking. It was set as a blocking floor of 0.90 before any judge result was seen; the first recorded run scored 0.87 (dev 0.82, test 0.93), and the owner chose to track it as a target rather than keep CI red. judge_set: thresholds for `cited-answers judge-eval`.
